questions.q: What does the RPM filter require?
options: A barometer and a GPS module
questions.explain: Bidirectional DShot and ESCs that support it: the filter needs the RPM over the return channel.

options: The lower limit of the notch
questions.explain: If the limit is above the real motor frequency, the filter sits beside the noise.

questions.q: Why must the minimum limit be lower for a 10" drone than for a 5"?
questions.explain: Frequency = RPM/60. Large props — slow motors — a low frequency.

questions.q: In the viking10 case rpm_filter_min_hz was 100, and the median motor frequency was 91 Hz. The consequence?
options: The filter did not see the motors
questions.explain: For most of the flight the RPM filter sat above the motor frequency: the 80–150 Hz noise was hardly filtered, and the D term was +44.5 dB.

questions.q: What does the DSHOT_TELEM flag (before 4.5 — RPMFILTER) in the OSD mean on arming?
options: The motors are overheated according to telemetry
There is no valid ESC telemetry
questions.explain: At least one ESC does not send telemetry — arming is blocked.

questions.q: After save, bidir is OFF again. What is this?
options: A broken ESC or its firmware
That is how it should be
questions.explain: After every save — re-read the values with get.

questions.q: rpm_filter_q = 500 sets a notch width of roughly:
questions.explain: Q is in hundredths; 500 → a quality factor of 5.

questions.q: What attenuation of the motor peaks after the RPM filter is normal?
The RPM filter is enabled, but the spectrum in Blackbox has not changed. What in this diff explains the problem?
questions.fragment:
# diff
set motor_pwm_protocol = DSHOT600
set dshot_bidir = OFF
set rpm_filter_harmonics = 3
set rpm_filter_min_hz = 100
options: dshot_bidir = OFF: without bidirectional DShot there is no eRPM, and the notches have nothing to tune to
rpm_filter_harmonics = 3 is excessive: the third harmonic eats phase and masks the result
rpm_filter_min_hz = 100 cuts off all the notches: the motors of this 5" spin below 100 Hz in hover
DSHOT600 is too fast for telemetry: the RPM filter works only on DSHOT300
questions.explain: The RPM filter takes the motor frequencies from eRPM telemetry; without dshot_bidir there is none, and the notches are not placed.
